reviewSummary: The independently calculated intended answers are correct, but many tasks fail the booklet question-type rule because the source only teaches their concepts or uses their tasks as intermediate solution steps. Repairs are also needed for an omitted normality assumption, an undefined boundary case, inaccurate distractor explanations and an unevaluated numerical option; no removals or worked examples were supplied.
